messages:
maria gonzalez: deploy-bot started staged rollout for release 2026.03.19-v2 to 20% traffic.

deploy-bot: /rollout start release=2026.03.19-v2 scope=global percent=20 initiated by @maria. Details: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026.03.19-v2 :rocket:

ian choi: seeing a 2.4x latency p50 on the canary pool compared to baseline, first noticed at 11:03 UTC. small microburst but sustained for ~5m.

taylor_ng: thanks — can you paste the query that spiked? any commonality? :mag:

ian choi: grep from canary logs:
```
2026-03-19T11:03:12Z ERROR serve: request_id=abc123 latency_ms=1984 model=redwood-13b-quant
2026-03-19T11:03:13Z WARN  kvcache: miss rate=0.42
```

maria gonzalez: hmm kv cache misses up. Could be cache warming/placement. Product-ops, this is inside our 2h change window right? we can hold without violating release SLA.

product-ops: correct, change window open until 13:00 UTC. hold call OK. Recommend hold at 20% and run extended canary for 30m while we investigate.

oncall-sre: load graphs — CPU on canaries hit 92% at spike, and we saw 504s increase to 0.9% from 0.02%.

maria gonzalez: i'm leaning towards pause and pin traffic back to 0% until we get root cause. anyone argue for proceeding to 50%?

taylor_ng: we should pause. If this is cache-related it's likely to regress at higher percents. +1 to pause.

ian choi: agreed. I'd also prefer to pin the model version for the next 24h to 2026.03.18-hotfix to keep production stable while we investigate.

maria gonzalez: ok actionable: 1) pause rollout; 2) pin routing to 2026.03.18-hotfix; 3) start a debug canary run on isolated pool; 4) create an incident if errors don't fall in 15m.

maria gonzalez: @deploy-bot please run:
```
/rollout pause release=2026.03.19-v2
/routing pin model=redwood-13b release=2026.03.18-hotfix
```

deploy-bot: acknowledged. pausing rollout... done.

deploy-bot: routing update queued. pin applied to prod: redwood-13b -> 2026.03.18-hotfix. will take effect in 20s. :white_check_mark:

oncall-sre: metrics back to baseline in last 4m after pin. error rate down to 0.03% and p50 returned to normal.

maria gonzalez: nice. skip rollback for now, but we will not resume the staged rollout until eng-runtime signs off on kernel/cache mitigation. tagging eng-runtime channel and opening a follow-up.

maria gonzalez: follow-up doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/2026-03-19-canary-holdback (short summary + action items).

product-ops: sending a short release-note update to stakeholders now. ETA 5m.

taylor_ng: filing an eval ticket for perf regression test and adding a quantization check to the preflight.

maria gonzalez: thanks all. marking this thread as resolved for go/no-go; decision=PAUSE_AND_PIN. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: thread closed by @maria gonzalez.
